excluded_boundaries.reason: A rate change with preserved pitch is not a change of speaker or timbre and does not convert the target voice.
Pitch, duration and energy controls alone do not implement content/speaker-disentangled voice conversion.
Changing pronunciation toward a target accent is not changing the designated speaker's timbre or identity.
Text-to-speech or cloning generates speech from text; it is not conversion of the supplied source utterance.
Recovering multiple source waveforms from a mixture is not converting one source speaker to a target voice.
Extracting or enhancing a known speaker in a mixture is not generating the same content in another voice.

excluded_boundaries.boundary: Quality and impairment assessment (OBS-01) and enhancement (CLN-01)
excluded_boundaries.reason: A converted waveform is not a quality score, and denoising or suppression is not voice conversion.
A transcript, translation or language label is not converted speech or a target-voice result.

historical_executions.label: MeanVC2 40+40 ms file-mode conversion
historical_executions.scope: One fixed English source utterance and one p360 target reference, file mode through the streaming chunk runner on one Apple M1 CPU. Whisper-tiny WER and the in-model target-encoder cosine are proxies; there is no physical microphone, device timing, listening or multi-speaker result. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: MeanVC2 120+40 ms file-mode conversion
historical_executions.scope: The same fixed source/target pair and host as HE-1, with the 120+40 ms configuration in file mode. The faster file RTF is not a microphone-to-output or first-audio latency result. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Seed-VC 25M file conversion
historical_executions.scope: Public 25M real-time preset, fixed source and p360 target, CPU file inference with four diffusion steps. The warm RTF is file throughput; the GUI/device path was not exercised and the weights were removed after the run. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: LLVC CPU streaming simulation
historical_executions.scope: Upstream infer.py streaming simulation, chunk factor 1, 16 kHz, on one fixed source. It misses the 13 ms chunk deadline by a wide margin; 120.785 ms is the upstream estimate and not a measured device-to-device latency. Target similarity is unscored. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: OpenVoice V2 offline tone-color conversion
historical_executions.scope: Whole-file offline tone-color conversion on one fixed pair. The cosine is OpenVoice's own in-model diagnostic, not an independent or perceptual identity score; no causal streaming path exists. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Chatterbox VC offline audio-to-audio conversion
historical_executions.scope: Third-party offline audio-to-audio converter on one fixed pair, CPU RTF 2.63. It is whole-file and far slower than real time on the historical host, so it is not a live-call result. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: RVC v2 VCTK p226 file conversion
historical_executions.scope: Official RVC PyTorch file pipeline with RMVPE F0 and retrieval disabled. The 109-embedding checkpoint has no speaker_info map, speaker_id 1 is presumed p226 and unverified, the FAISS index crashes, and no real-time/device path was run. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Seed-VC Realtime one 240 ms block
historical_executions.scope: One first 240 ms block through upstream Seed-VC Realtime custom_infer on CPU. It is a generic VC path, not the accent-aware V2 path; the output is too short for meaningful ASR or identity comparison and the block is not a warmed-up sustained stream. not rerun by this survey.

historical_executions.label: Vocos JIT decoder CPU timing on synthetic mel
historical_executions.scope: Decoder-only CPU timing on a synthetic 1 s 80-bin mel input, mean over five post-warm-up calls. It is not voice conversion, not an end-to-end pipeline latency and not a quality assessment. not rerun by this survey.
